classification_contract.promotion_membership: exact membership in authoritative participation manifest only
classification_contract.returning_status: exact canonical global identity with prior top-division participation evidence only

data_roles.untouched_confirmation: 2026/27 future fixtures sealed only after this preregistration; no already-started fixture without a pre-existing sealed receipt is eligible
data_roles.same_day_rule: predict every same-kickoff/day batch before applying any result from that batch

cold_start_candidate.allowed_when: authoritative promoted identity AND no legal lower-tier xG state sufficient for FUSION_V2_ACTIVE
cold_start_candidate.single_structure: Frozen V1 15x15 score matrix exponentially tilted by a PIT lower-tier result strength differential plus one development-estimated global tier-gap scalar; renormalize once and derive all 1X2/score/total probabilities from that same matrix

lower_tier_strength.history: match results only, strictly before target cutoff
lower_tier_strength.strength_stat: log((decayed_GF + prior)/(decayed_GA + prior)) relative to lower-tier league scoring environment

tier_gap_parameter.name: global_big5_promoted_tier_gap
tier_gap_parameter.fit_rule: single maximum-likelihood scalar on development promoted-fixture score outcomes only; no league-specific or club-specific constants
tier_gap_parameter.selection_use: frozen after development fit; 2025/26 is evaluation only

cold_start_candidate.promoted_vs_promoted: both promoted strengths enter symmetrically; common tier gap cancels mechanically
cold_start_candidate.old_vs_old: candidate transform is identity; formal route remains unchanged
cold_start_candidate.missing_optional_inputs: player/transfer/expected-XI/injury/market inputs may only enter a future separately preregistered extension; they are excluded from this v1 candidate unless exact PIT availability is proven before label read

evaluation_cohort.historical_target: first four top-division league fixtures per promoted club per season, deduplicated by fixture identity

stop_rules.STOP_DATA_COVERAGE: required identity/history/state or minimum evaluable cohort cannot be built without protected/unlicensed/non-PIT data
stop_rules.STOP_NO_CANDIDATE: the one preregistered low-DoF candidate fails the frozen gates; no rescue tuning
stop_rules.PARTIAL_DATA_COVERAGE: some leagues/teams satisfy legal xG or cold-start evidence but not all
stop_rules.FAIL_RESEARCH_ONLY: engineering/scientific contract, leakage, identity, reproducibility or no-drift gate fails

activation_policy: No formal activation in this branch. Any historical candidate pass still requires new 2026/27 strictly prospective confirmation before a separate governed activation proposal.
